description.zh:
资产类型。取值：
- ip：ip
- domain：域名
- url：url
- process：进程
- file：文件
- host：主机
description.en:
The asset type. Valid values:

- ip: IP address

- domain: domain name

- url: URL

- process: process

- file: file

- host: host

description.zh: 列表当前页号， 大于等于1。
description.en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

description.zh: 列表每页条数， 最大不超过100。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is deployed. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong)

- ap-southeast-1: assets outside China

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member whose data you want to view. This parameter is available only when an administrator wants to switch to the perspective of a member.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.

title.zh: 获取事件关联资产列表
